lede: Monday night, Telluride Town Council votes on the 2027 budget and the property tax levy that funds it — and in the same session takes a second reading on an ordinance that would suspend the Open Space Fund's 5% cut of Real Estate Transfer Tax revenue for the year, a real tension between keeping the lights on and protecting the land-conservation commitment this community has long held. Also Monday, the School Board debriefs on November ballot results including the 5A mill levy override, which will shape school funding for years ahead, and the Fire District takes its budget to a second reading alongside early construction financing discussions. By the end of the week, the gondola reopens for winter.

notable.stake: Council votes on 2027 budget, property tax levy, and open-space fund suspension.
